{{short description|German mathematician}}
{{use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=July 2020}}
'''Martina Zähle''' (born 1950){{r|born}} is a German mathematician specializing in [[geometric measure theory]] and [[stochastic geometry]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Jena]], where she holds the chair for geometry.{{r|jena}}

Zähle completed her doctorate in 1978 at the University of Jena. Her dissertation, ''Ergodizitätseigenschaften von Strömungsmodellen mit Anwendungen in der Bedienungstheorie'', was supervised by Joseph Mecke.{{r|mg}} She earned a [[habilitation]] at Jena in 1982.{{r|hab}}

She is the coauthor of the book ''Curvature Measures of Singular Sets'' (with Jan Rataj, Springer, 2019).{{r|cmss}}
